title: David Huggins' encounters with mantids, grays and a hybrid woman
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of David Huggins' encounters with mantids, grays and a hybrid woman, about from childhood onward at US South; underground places, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And he claimed that the mantids were in charge of these little grays

plain: A writer named Jason Jorjani, on podcast host Jesse Michels' show, relays the claims of a man named David Huggins, who says he had encounters with non-human beings from childhood on, in the American South and in underground places. According to Huggins, these included tall insect-like beings called mantids, small grey beings called grays, and a woman who was part human. Huggins claimed the mantids were in charge of the little grays, which would suggest these beings have a chain of command.
